matrix_convention: local_matrix and world_matrix are 16 floats ROW-MAJOR (row 0 first); M = T * Ry * Rx * Rz * S (R_deg = pitch X, yaw Y, roll Z); world = parent_world * M; the code stores Mat4 column-major (m[col*4+row]); world matrices are at t = 0
